subject: CAIQ evidence: embedded SDK telemetry artifacts + OpenAPI contract
messages:
From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@finnbank.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finnbank.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ - ask: embedded SDK telemetry + API contracts

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security review team needs a compact set of artifacts to map Redwood's embedded SDK telemetry to the CAIQ controls. Specifically we're looking for:

- telemetry schema (what fields are emitted, sample logs)
- retention policy for SDK-level events
- confirmation that PII is never sent in telemetry by default and how to opt-out
- the OpenAPI contract for the customer-facing API surface you referenced

Can you also run through a short walkthrough (30–40 minutes) that shows: SDK instrumentation -> where telemetry lands -> how it's indexed for evidence? We want to lock this into our CAIQ control annotations this week.

Ideally we get the artifacts and a proposed slot before EOD Tuesday PT.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior InfoSec Manager
FinnBank

--
Attachment request: please attach any schema or sample logs (json/yaml/xlsx).

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@finnbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - ask: embedded SDK telemetry + API contracts

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan:

1) I'll prepare a compact evidence bundle: telemetry schema, 2 anonymized sample events, and the OpenAPI spec for the tenant/admin APIs.
2) Kim (security) will confirm retention and PII handling language so you can map to CAIQ control CCM G2/G4 type items.
3) Propose a 40-minute walkthrough: Tuesday 2027-06-01 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET — does that work?

I attached the initial artifacts I can share immediately: sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json, openapi-contracts-v2.yaml, and caiq-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx. (See attachments stub below.)

If you need more granular logs or a telemetry export sample, Marissa will coordinate a small incremental evidence batch — we can mark it as a short-lived upload for audit sampling.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json (application/json) — field definitions and examples; openapi-contracts-v2.yaml (text/yaml) — OpenAPI 3.1 export of public/admin endpoints; caiq-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet) — mapping table for CAIQ controls.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@finnbank.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - ask: embedded SDK telemetry + API contracts

Hi Alice, Marcus — looping in a short checklist and clarifications from security side so you can map items to CAIQ controls:

- Retention: SDK telemetry is stored in the telemetry ingestion tier for 30 days by default; aggregated metrics are kept 13 months. If FinnBank needs a different retention window for evidence, we can produce time-bound snapshots (exported CSV/NDJSON) for audit purposes.
- PII: by design, the SDK strips known PII fields (email, ssn, cc numbers) before transmission. We also offer a field-level redaction setting at instrumentation time.
- Sampling and logs for evidence: we can generate a timestream export with a signed manifest and hash for sampling (useful for CAIQ traceability).
- Evidence mapping pointers: for CCM controls related to logging/monitoring and data minimization, reference section 2.1–2.4 in the attached caiq-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx.

Requests for you, FinnBank: please confirm the list of control IDs you want annotated (we commonly get: L1-Logging, DM-DataHandling, ID-Identities). That'll let us prioritize what sample artifacts to produce.

Thanks — Kim
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

[Forwarded note: sample manifest format in the spreadsheet; we will provide an export that includes SHA256 hashes and timestamps.]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@finnbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - ask: embedded SDK telemetry + API contracts

Alice — thanks, Kim. FinnBank — confirming Tuesday 2027-06-01 10:00 PT still works for a walkthrough; we'll keep it tight to 40 minutes and focus on:

- a short demo (10m) showing SDK instrumentation and how events are transformed
- the ingestion pipeline and where evidence artifacts live (10m)
- mapping demo: we will walk through two CAIQ control IDs you specify (15m)
- Q&A and next steps (5m)

I've uploaded a temporary evidence batch (read-only link) for you to inspect ahead of the session: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-finbank-caiq-evidence (expires in 7 days). The batch contains: sdk-telemetry-schema-v1.json, anonymized-sample-events-20270529.ndjson, openapi-contracts-v2.yaml, and the caiq-evidence-checklist-v1.xlsx.

If you confirm the two control IDs now, Kim and I will prepare the mapping worksheets and an export manifest.

Regards,
Marcus

--
Attachment stubs included in the drive folder. Deal: DEAL-8271.

From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@finnbank.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ - ask: embedded SDK telemetry + API contracts

All good — thanks for the quick turnaround. 10:00 PT tomorrow (2027-06-01) actually would have been fine but we've aligned internally and the security reviewers asked to move to Wednesday 2027-06-02 11:30 PT — can you confirm availability?

Control IDs we'll prioritize: L1-Logging and DM-DataHandling. We also want to confirm one more item during the call: if a customer is in EU and uses the embedded SDK, is any telemetry routed outside of the selected region by default? (If so, we'll need notes for CAIQ residency mapping.)

I'll review the drive bundle and share any annotation requests before the walkthrough.

Regards,
Alice
Senior InfoSec Manager, FinnBank
